text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The Positive Energy Districts transition pathway (PED) aims to optimise the local energy system through energy efficiency, flexibility and local energy generation from renewables in actions towards the (urban) energy transition and climate-neutrality and mainstreaming these actions in urban planning processes.", "gist": "PED aims to optimize local energy systems using efficiency, flexibility, and renewable energy for urban energy transition and climate neutrality, integrating these actions into urban planning."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Positive Energy Districts transition pathway (PED)", "gist": "PED: a transition pathway for positive energy districts"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "public administrations, real estate developers and utilities", "gist": "key stakeholder groups for PED development"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "PED development strongly builds on the cooperation of key stakeholder groups like public administrations, real estate developers and utilities.", "gist": "PED development relies heavily on cooperation among public administrations, real estate developers, and utilities."}]}
